def process(load_reports) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_reports.copy()
    df.columns = ['Year', 'Fraud', 'Identity_Theft', 'Other']
    df = df[df['Year'].notna()].copy()
    df = df[df['Year'] != 'Year'].copy()
    df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)
    df['Identity_Theft'] = df['Identity_Theft'].str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
    return df[df['Year'].isin([2001, 2024])][['Year', 'Identity_Theft']]

def process(load_reports) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_reports.copy()
    df.columns = ['Year', 'Fraud', 'Identity_Theft', 'Other']
    df = df[df['Year'].notna()].copy()
    df = df[df['Year'] != 'Year'].copy()
    df = df[~df['Year'].str.contains('Source', na=False, case=False)].copy()
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['Year'].notna()].copy()
    df['Identity_Theft'] = df['Identity_Theft'].str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
    return df[df['Year'].isin([2001, 2024])][['Year', 'Identity_Theft']]
